facts.fact: DHIS2's country profile (updated July 2026) says DHIS2 has been the national health management information system since 2022, covering routine data on a range of health programmes with malaria data collected monthly, describes the DHIS2 systems as locally owned, and says HISP Rwanda gives the Ministry of Health technical assistance and capacity building.
facts.system: DHIS2 national health management information system (HMIS)

systems.system: DHIS2 national health management information system (HMIS)

systems.system: DHIS2 Climate & Health instance (malaria early warning)
systems.platform: DHIS2 with the DHIS2 Climate App, Chap Modeling Platform and DHIS2 Modeling App
systems.owner: Ministry of Health and National Malaria Control Programme, set up by HISP Rwanda with World Bank (COMPASS) funding to June 2026
systems.tiers: testing instance; piloted in the Ngazidja region

systems.system: National Malaria Control Programme weekly malaria data collection
systems.platform: not stated; kept in parallel to DHIS2 and being imported into it
